author: GB Patch Games
title: Hiring guest artists for visual novel
content: We’re hiring guest artists! GB Patch Games is looking for artists (who specialize in digital art) for: Our monthly guest art; Upcoming celebrations for the Early Access release of Our Life: Now & Forever. Interested in commissioning for us? Reach out on any of our socials via DMs with your rates and a portfolio (or a few examples of your work). You can also email support@gbpatchgames.com with your information.
